values.en: For an arc-length parametrized curve $\gamma$ with $\gamma''\neq 0$, the **Frenet frame** is the ordered triple $(\boldsymbol{t}_\gamma, \boldsymbol{n}_\gamma, \boldsymbol{b}_\gamma)$ of the tangent vector, the principal normal vector and the binormal vector, so that at a parameter value $t$ it takes the value $(\boldsymbol{t}_\gamma(t), \boldsymbol{n}_\gamma(t), \boldsymbol{b}_\gamma(t))$. The Frenet frame is thus a function of the parameter whose value is an ordered triple of vectors. Its two properties are stated as separate subentries: the triple is orthonormal, and the triple is right-handed, i.e. $\boldsymbol{b}_\gamma(t)=\boldsymbol{t}_\gamma(t)\wedge\boldsymbol{n}_\gamma(t)$.
values.zh-CN: 对满足 $\gamma''\neq 0$ 的以弧长为参数的曲线 $\gamma$，**Frenet 标架**是切向量、主法向量与副法向量组成的有序三元组 $(\boldsymbol{t}_\gamma, \boldsymbol{n}_\gamma, \boldsymbol{b}_\gamma)$，在参数 $t$ 处的取值为 $(\boldsymbol{t}_\gamma(t), \boldsymbol{n}_\gamma(t), \boldsymbol{b}_\gamma(t))$。因此 Frenet 标架是一个依参数的函数，其取值是向量的有序三元组。它的两条性质另立为子条目：该三元组规范正交，且为右手系，即 $\boldsymbol{b}_\gamma(t)=\boldsymbol{t}_\gamma(t)\wedge\boldsymbol{n}_\gamma(t)$。
